shortDescription: Liquefied natural gas prices are unlikely to fall in the near term after surging since the start of the US-Iran war, according to Bloomberg reported. Chevron Corp.'s Australia president said the market is expected to stay high for six months.

title: Chevron Australia Sees LNG Prices Staying Elevated for Six Months
